name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It preserves fine details in complex scenes better than standard upscalers, which directly boosts EXCAVA’s output quality without extra compute cost. The trade-off is a slight slowdown in processing time, but the quality gain outweighs it.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscalers won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop because the core problem is motion blur from EXCAVA’s generator, not resolution loss. Test InstantX’s upscaler on EXCAVA’s worst-case frames—if face fidelity doesn’t improve, the idea dies. If it does, we’ll measure the slowdown and decide if the trade-off is worth it.
